correctness.rationale: The one-cap two-amplitude construction is internally consistent. With N parallel disjoint packet tubes, L balls per tube, delta=(N-1)^(-1/6), Y the L balls on the strong tube, and W=NL, the global sixth-power mass is 2L while the Y mass is L. Thus the ratio against the stated (M/W)^(1/6) factor is exactly (N/2)^(1/6). For N comparable to R^(3/2) this is a constant multiple of R^(1/4). The deposited exact checker and an independent recomputation reproduce this scaling. The remaining analytic passage is the standard cone wave-packet realization, with only absolute-constant tail/boundary losses.
